Preparation

File › Open PDF script… (only PDFs with selectable text, e.g. exported from Word or LibreOffice). In light blue the words excluded from recognition: stage directions in brackets, italics and bold (titles, lights), lines like «MUSIC:», the table of contents. Change them with the menu on the word.

Click a word (or drag over several words): ＋ OSC button or ＋ Note on that word. Each button can send several OSC commands to the OSC profiles (Settings › OSC profiles, also with the network search), and have notes and images. The plugins (CueStage, QLab, SCS, ChamSys MagicQ, Generic) offer ready-made commands. In preparation a click on a button edits it; right click = edit, test, delete.

Save the project (.sfollow) next to the PDF: it holds buttons, notes, included/excluded words and the OSC profiles.

Show

LISTEN (F5) starts recognition from the chosen channel (Settings › Audio and gate). The line being spoken is highlighted in yellow and the view follows it. Points already passed turn grey; the next button and the next note blink. The Next event panel shows the sentences before the button (words already spoken in yellow) and the button: Space sends it.

The last button passed stays pressable (orange if it was not sent) until you press the next button: pressing a button disables the previous ones.

❚❚ Pause listening (F8): manual mode, the position moves only by hand; ▶ Resume listening restarts from the current position (the model stays loaded).

Double-click a word = restart from there (also Ctrl+↑ / Ctrl+↓ by line). Going back, the following points are re-enabled. If you scroll by hand, the view stops following for 5 seconds (or turn off «Follow», F6).

Timing

With ⏺ Timing on (F7) each performance records the time between one event and the next. Next to «Next event» the estimated time (average of the performances) and the countdown appear.

Gate

Below the threshold the recognizer gets silence: the white cursor on the meter (also the one at the top) sets the threshold. Best is a mixer send with only the voices, no music or effects.

Languages

Language › Script language: Italian (included), English, Slovenian; the models are downloaded from Language › Recognition languages. Language › Interface language: italiano, English, slovenščina.

Without actors

Show › Test with an audio file (F9, or drag the file onto the window): the recording of a rehearsal or a performance (WAV, FLAC, MP3, OGG; with ffmpeg also M4A and video) goes through the gate and the recognizer as if it came from the sound card, even sped up to 3×. Show › Simulate speech (F4): type sentences or let it read the script with random errors.
<b>frasi</b>: le frasi dette, fino al pu: sentences: the sentences spoken, up to the button's point · lines: the script lines as laid out, stage directions included · words: only the last words spoken (the most compact panel). Words already spoken turn yellow, the button's word is green.

Il modello vocale riconosce solo le paro: The speech model only recognises the words in its vocabulary: a script word it does not know (proper names, neologisms, numbers in digits…) will never be «heard». Adding new words to the model cannot be done from here: it requires recompiling its graph, with tools Alphacephei provides only on request. You can, however, give each word a pronunciation made of words the model knows (e.g. «Gesualdi» → «gesù aldi»): it will be recognised and attached to the script word. Unknown words without a pronunciation are skipped by the following without penalty. Numbers in digits are already read as words (118 → one hundred eighteen).
